content:
anya: quick incident: debug traces contained emails for one tenant. investigation points to header ordering: legacy proxy adds routing header after our single scrub pass.

samir: so route-aware rules never ran. two quick directions: move route-detection earlier or add a tiny pre-scrub.

lina: pre-scrub should be a minimal regex pass (email, cc, common api-key prefixes). keep false positives low.

marta: perf note: extra scrub increases CPU and can hit quota thresholds. tagging high-volume tenants for Dedicated/edge offload could mitigate.

devex: Console implications: we'll need a visible indicator when pre-scrub ran e.g. badge "early-redacted" and a toggle to show routed view. add tooltip explaining why fields differ.

ops-bot: telemetry request: add counters redact_pass_count, early_scrub_applied, sampled_unmask_count, route_attest_failures.

anya: I want a safer debug flow: sampled_unmask where we allow occasional unredact for debugging but only with strict audit (who, why, TTL). sample rate configurable per-tenant and gated by policy.

samir: sampled_unmask is interesting but dangerous. enforce: (1) SRE approval via Slack flow, (2) Legal cc, (3) one-use ephemeral token, (4) TTL=5m, (5) metric and alert on >2 uses/day.

lina: we can implement sampled_unmask as server-side only — Console shows a placeholder link "Request unmask" which triggers the approval flow. No client-side toggle.

marta: routing attestation plan: require proxies to sign route header with HMAC (X-Route-Signature). validate early and skip pre-scrub for signed requests. rollout ~3w.

anya: short-term: enable pre-scrub behind tenant-flag for routes known to come from legacy proxies. medium-term: implement route-attest and sampled_unmask runbook.

ops-bot: created ticket PRIV-DBG-007 and added dashboard placeholders for redaction metrics.

devex: docs: add note about sampled_unmask policy and Console badge copy. include troubleshooting steps listing how to request unmask.

anya: action items:
- lina: draft minimal regex ruleset + PR (due Tue)
- samir: perf delta estimate for pre-scrub vs attestation path (due Mon)
- marta: runbook stub for sampled_unmask approval flow (due Thu)
- devex: Console badge + docs copy (due Wed)
- ops-bot: wire up metrics redact_pass_count, early_scrub_applied, sampled_unmask_count (due Mon)

anya: I'll follow up with a short note to CS for customer notification templates. ping me if you see other header-mutating proxies.
